name: Cummins
description: Engine and power generation OEM from Columbus, Indiana whose Centum Force range factory-pre-integrates QSK60 gensets (2.0-2.75 MW, 50 Hz) into stackable ISO 40-ft containers; its Accelera brand supplies PEM electrolyzers and fuel cells.

sources.note: Cummins Centum Force brochure 6545129 (distributor-hosted), read 26 October 2026

notes: cummins.com blocked the automated fetcher (HTTP 403); figures come from the official brochure PDF and the APAC generators page. Accelera (zero-emissions brand: HyLYSER electrolyzers, fuel cells) folded into this record 2026-10-29; the separately created Cummins (Accelera) record was removed as a duplicate sub-brand.
